newsitem.title: USA: Cook County, Ill. offering early retire pact-paper.
newsitem.headline: Cook County, Ill. offering early retire pact-paper.

text.p: Nearly 3,600 of the more than 27,000 employees of Cook County will be offered early retirement incentives in an effort to cut the workforce and reduce the need for layoffs, the Chicago Sun-Times reported Friday.

County officials expect about 1,500 of the eligible employees to take the offer for an early pension, but they have not targeted particular positions for reductions or stated how much Cook County hopes to save through the program, the Sun-Times reported.
County Board President John Stroger's plan needs legislative approval, the newspaper reported.
Employees with at least 10 years service who have also reaced age 55 by the end of next February would be eligible, the Sun-Times reported.
Those eligible for the program earn an average of $40,000 annually with another $10,000 in benefits, the Sun-Times reported.
